notes: Captured 2026-09-03 from Topo Designs' own Shopify storefront: the rendered product page plus the Black-specific variant page (https://topodesigns.com/products/rover-pack-tech-black), since Black and Navy are sold as two separate product handles rather than one product with a colour option. topodesigns.com/robots.txt is a standard Shopify agent-facing robots.txt (Allow on product/collection pages, Disallow on /admin, /cart, /checkout, /account and AJAX endpoints) so this fetch is permitted. IN PRODUCTION: both listings are live at $149.00 with no compare-at price; Navy is in stock, Black currently reads 'Sold out' on its own page but remains a listed, orderable-when-restocked colourway rather than a removed one, so it is still captured. (An unrelated stale search hit, 'rover-pack-tech-final-sale-1', 404s and is not this product.) PRICE COMPARISON was brand-direct only: REI's 'Topo Designs Rover Pack' listing ($109) is the Classic, not the Tech, and is a different product, so it was not used; Huckberry lists a Rover Pack Tech but its storefront returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on every path; Amazon's Rover Pack Tech listing (B0DTV2VZV9) rendered no price in the fetched HTML (JS-loaded pricing), so it is recorded as not captured rather than guessed. Both colorway hexes were sampled with `pnpm sample-swatch` from Topo's own full-resolution (1946px) product photographs; swatchSource records which. Neither name needed a family override - colorFamilyFromName resolves 'Black' -> black and 'Navy' -> navy cleanly against the sampled hexes.
